description: Change an auto-buy rule by id: pause or resume it with `isActive`, or change any of price cap, amount, duration, threshold and limits (only the fields you send change). Side effect: a resumed or loosened rule can start spending internal TRX again. Idempotent for the same arguments. Get ids from `tronsave_list_auto_buy_settings`. Requires a wallet signature identity.

durationSec.description: Delegation duration of each purchase, in seconds.

endActiveAt.description: Optional Unix time in seconds when the rule stops.

isActive.description: false pauses the rule, true resumes it.

limitBudgetInSun.description: Optional total budget cap in SUN (decimal string); must be greater than 10000000 (10 TRX).

limitInOrderCount.description: Optional cap on the number of orders.

receiver.description: TRON base58 address that receives each delegation.

resourceAmount.description: Resource units bought each time the rule fires.

startActiveAt.description: Optional Unix time in seconds when the rule starts.

thresholdResourceAmount.description: Rule fires when the receiver's remaining resource drops below this many units (TronSave requires at least 100000).

unitPrice.description: Maximum unit price in SUN, as a decimal string.

name: tronsave_update_auto_buy_setting
title: Update Auto-Buy Rule
